notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello! Update [b]1.2.0[/b] is here!

[b]Interface:[/b]
  -Added Spanish localization.
  -Fixed many bugs in Russian localization.
  -Fixed some bugs in the diary interface.

[b]And:[/b]
  -Many minor fixes.

Thanks for your feedback! I try to fix bugs in a timely manner, as well as add new features. You can discuss the game and report bugs in the [url=https://discord.gg/9SuJekE9uQ][u]Discord[/u][/url] channel!

Artesign.

notes.title: v1.1.8c Small update + Announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
 
- V-sync is now enabled by default (this helps fix the "tearing" of the image).
- Language change buttons added to the main menu.
- Minor localization fixes.

Announcement:
- A translation of the game into Spanish is in preparation!

Artesign.

notes.title: Update 1.1.8
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.1.8 is here!

Localization:
-English localization has been updated.

Interface:
-Improved interaction with the Elenhos console. Now it is not necessary to enter commands manually - corresponding buttons have been added.
-Added a small target when drawing with TouchInput (it can also be disabled in the settings).
-Added a "Default" button in the game settings.
-Improved interaction with the Water Storage (reactor), now the tanks slide automatically.
-Minor fixes to the description of the Fountain task.

Bugs:
-Fixed an issue that could occur with the interaction of the CPS and fuses.
-Fixed an issue where the doors in the reactor control area could close prematurely.

Artesign.

notes.title: v1.1.7b Hotfix
notes.content:
v1.1.7b Hotfix:

-Fixed a bug due to which the book in the hand of the Day Keeper statue was not visible.

Artesign

notes.title: Update 1.1.7
notes.content:
Hello! Update 1.1.7 is here!

Sound:
- Added a new song (for locations: night and laboratory).

Interface:
-Added sorting of quests (by date of receipt and stages of passage).
- Added sorting of notes (by date received and in order).
- The "hide completed tasks" option now supports saves.
- Items no longer change with the mouse wheel when the diary is open.
- Updated tooltip on death.


Saves:
- Fixed a bug due to which the bones could be duplicated if using old saves.
- Fixed an issue where items in the transformer might not show up if you're using an old save.

And:
- Minor fix in English localization (will also be improved in the future).
- Chests dug out of treasures have been slightly adjusted.
- Slightly adjusted values for microscope images.
- And other small changes.

Thanks for your feedback! I try to fix bugs in a timely manner, as well as add new features. You can discuss the game and report bugs in the Discord channel!

Artesign.

notes.title: v1.1.6 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello, urgent inclusion!

-Fixed a critical bug due to which, with some probability, things in the excavated treasure could not appear!
If you've already dug up treasures, you can dig them up again and pick up the missing items! (Notes that you already have cannot be picked up!).

Artesign.

notes.title: v1.1.5 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello!

Main:
-Fixed a critical bug where, with some probability, the converter doors might not open by the end of the game.
-TouchInput speed has been adjusted and now depends on mouse speed and two new settings.

Interface:
-Changed the button for changing the font in the diary, now it can be seen more clearly.
- Updated Discord link.
-Added mail for communication.
-Changed the description of the kneecaps to distinguish where is the right and where is the left.

Other:
-Fixed default FPS limit to 60 (again).
-Small fix with saving/loading reactor control system.

Artesign.
